answer.text:
According to Utz Brands, Inc.'s Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended December 29, 2024, the figures for the fiscal year ended December 29, 2024 are as follows:

- **Gross profit:** $494,777 thousand (or $494.8 million)
- **Net sales:** $1,409,281 thousand (or $1,409.3 million)

### **Calculation:**
$$\text{Gross Profit Margin} = \frac{\text{Gross profit}}{\text{Net sales}} = \frac{494,777}{1,409,281} \approx 35.1084\% \text{ (or } 35.1\%)$$

The report also explicitly states:
> *"Our gross profit margin was 35.1% for the fiscal year ended December 29, 2024 versus 31.7% for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2023."*

**Citation:** 
- Accession: `0001739566-25-000053`, Section: `Item 7. Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations`, Chunk ID: `14e6d7a8-d96c-5bc1-a7d5-febc26908e92`.
